source_of_truth: Reading app/composables/useOnboarding.ts: localStorage.setItem('password-strength-tips-seen', true) uses a credential-sounding key but stores a boolean UI flag (the user dismissed a hint), not a secret. The code alone does not prove this is or is not a credential, so the only honest verdict is a heuristic 'read this key' finding; a confirmed token-in-web-storage would be a false positive. A correct auditor reports token-in-web-storage at heuristic (not confirmed).

expected.rationale: Credential word in the key but a literal boolean value: genuinely ambiguous. Heuristic ('read it') is the correct level; confirming it would over-state the evidence.
